why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Read the docs overview Open the QMS docs for the overview of the proof-of-useful-work design and the note on the v0.1 preview release.
2 Step 2 : Add QMS Testnet to your wallet The onboarding guide shows how to set up a wallet for the testnet.
3 Step 3 : Send a first transaction Continue through the same onboarding guide to make a first transaction on the testnet.
4 Step 4 : Point your Ethereum tools at QMS Developers can follow the For Developers page to point familiar Ethereum tooling at QMS and deploy a contract.

5 Step 5 : Sign up for updates On the QMS homepage , the Get involved form asks for a name or nickname, email, Telegram, an X connection and a role chosen from a list. It is how the project shares news and developer material.
